title: Adjunction-normalized finite evaluation of coefficient-system comparisons
statement: Fix the whole-system coefficient model family $D$ of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models], the recorded exact evaluations of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], and finite scalar and compact-support operations of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image], with finite scalar extension $C_{T,n}$ and its adjunction from [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. For $E\le F$, a scalar evaluation datum at $n$ consists of an ordinary restriction/evaluation isomorphism whose maps are identity on all sections, its exact derived localization, and an isomorphism $C_{T,\bullet}\operatorname{ev}_{F,n}\simeq\operatorname{ev}_{E,n}C_{T,n}$ (functors written in diagrammatic order). Its normalization is the equality of its right adjunction mate with that derived restriction/evaluation isomorphism, for the actual system and finite scalar adjunctions. Equivalently, evaluation commutes with their adjunction transposes. These are data and explicit definitions, without an existence assertion.
